answer: Require each identity to lock 155 POA in a vault for 54 epochs and complete twelve unpredictable jobs per round, with an 11-of-20 established jury signing replayable receipts. One missed round freezes rewards; two slash 80% of the timber bond. Funding-linked entrants follow an umber curve where every new bond doubles, making clone costs geometric. The ledger verifies task hashes, quorum signatures, timestamps, and funding ancestry.
